stage1.impression: A clear cast cylinder with stacked lens voids stands on a pale silver disc on a mid-grey glossy round surface against a bright grey sweep; the acrylic's refraction and side highlights are believable. But the disc and the surface read as brushed aluminium and grey plastic rather than a dark label and black vinyl, half the voids have flat saturated-blue cores that read as decals, and the far edge of the round surface runs almost tangent to the weight's top rim.

blocking_9: The centre label reads as the specified dark satin: region [370,790,450,860] lum_median <= 100 and delta_e to #2B2B2D < 25 (now 170, dE 48.5)
The LP reads as glossy black vinyl with a few highlights, not mid-grey: [100,1000,400,1150] lum_median <= 70 (now 95) and [50,470,300,560] <= 100 (now 145)
No void core reads as flat saturated blue-black: void [690,650,760,668] r_median >= 30 (now 1) and lum_median >= 90 (now 62); every void shows a silver TIR rim around a lit interior
The weight has a darker base where it sits on the label, so it reads as resting on the record and not floating in a pale band: [560,780,820,880] lum_median <= 170 (now 206)
The LP's far edge no longer runs tangent to the weight's top rim (now both at about y 340-380); at least 40 px of clear background or clear overlap between them

changes.problem: The label and the vinyl mirror the brightest band of the cove: the specular direction from the record at the camera's 17 degree elevation lands at about z 270 at y 900, which is exactly where the wall light's wash is aimed, so the dark satin label renders as silver and the black vinyl as grey.

evidence.measured: label lum_median 170.3, RGB 173/170/166, delta_e2000 to #2B2B2D 48.5; LP back-left [50,470,300,560] lum_median 145; cove profile y peaks 239 at the horizon band

changes.expected: The cove stays bright in the upper frame (lum about 215-235) while the band the record mirrors drops; the label falls toward its own dark satin value and the vinyl darkens by 40 or more levels at the back.

changes.problem: Even off the wash spot, the cove is a near-white field that the glossy vinyl mirrors at every angle, so the record has no black anywhere and the front reads mid-grey.

evidence.measured: LP front lum_median 95.3, range 11.7 (one flat grey); cove [100,50,1700,300] lum_median 230

changes.expected: Background still reads light grey (lum about 190-215) for a bright-field hero; vinyl front drops to near-black with its reflection of the weight standing out.

changes.problem: Nothing behind or above the camera gives the near half of the record and the label a dark field to mirror; the front of the label reads 149 and the front of the weight's base picks the same pale value up by refraction.

evidence.measured: front label lum_median 149, RGB 150/149/148 against a specified #2B2B2D

change.to: matte black card 600 x 300 mm, reflectance 3 percent, at (40, -520, 260), facing the target, held clear of the camera's view

changes.expected: The front band of the label and the vinyl between the label and the frame edge darken; the weight's lower half refracts a dark label and gains a base.

changes.problem: About half the voids show cores of saturated blue-black (red channel 1) where the path through them is trapped by total internal reflection and ends in no light, so they read as painted blue ellipses rather than air.

evidence.measured: void lum_median 62, r_median 1, g 74, b 124; a neighbouring silver void [900,600,960,625] reads 142 neutral

changes.expected: Low raking light from the back-right enters the side wall at the voids' height and feeds the trapped paths; the cores go from blue-black to a lit, cool-silver interior with a brighter rim, red channel at least 30.

changes.problem: The record's far edge runs almost tangent to the weight's top rim, so the horizon line clips the top lamina and flattens the silhouette.

evidence.measured: the LP's far edge sits at y 370-470 behind the top rim at y 330-380; LP_profile drops from 163 to 138 across the band where the two lines meet

changes.expected: The camera drops about 4 degrees; the record's far edge falls below the top rim, and the top lamina silhouettes against the cove with a clean edge and a less busy top face.

changes.problem: The left wall carries a full-height clipped highlight band about 50 px wide, which reads as a white stripe rather than a polished edge highlight with a falloff.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 15.7, lum_p95 255; edge [430,600,520,640] 10-90 width 56 px with only a 20 level step

changes.expected: The left highlight stays the brightest value on the weight but rolls off instead of clipping; clipped share in that strip under 3 percent.

out_of_scope.request: Make the voids' blue cores less saturated by reducing the lamina tint
out_of_scope.why: The acrylic's tint absorption is fixed from the maker's chart; the saturated blue-black cores (R=1) are the largest remaining reason the voids read as decals, so if c4 does not lift them the tint model of the 3 mm lamina should be checked against the chart.

out_of_scope.request: Thin out or shift the voids that overlap the top face and the central column
out_of_scope.why: Void layout is fixed geometry; viewed through the top lamina they make a dense jumble that competes with the side voids, which c5 reduces only by lowering the camera.
